semiconductor_relevance: High — INFICON develops and manufactures Residual Gas Analyzers and other instrumentation critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: INFICON is a leading provider of Residual Gas Analyzers (RGAs) and critical sensor technologies that enhance productivity and quality in semiconductor manufacturing. Their products are essential for gas leak detection and process monitoring in the fabrication of semiconductors and thin film coatings.

regional_presence.China: INFICON China operates as a wholly-owned subsidiary, providing localized sales and technical support across major cities.
